name: Funding flip ignition — sentiment turns positive, ride the trend birth (long spot)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC + cross-event op capturing a REGIME-BIRTH no existing spec targets. Funding sign is the perp market's revealed directional bias: it spends downtrends NEGATIVE (shorts dominant) and the MOMENT it crosses UP through zero into positive marks bears capitulating and the leverage tide turning bullish. Most funding specs read funding as a steady-state level (carry to harvest, or a crowding ceiling). This one reads the DERIVATIVE event — the flip — as a trend-ignition catalyst, and CONFIRMS it with price momentum already turning up (so we ride a born trend, not a single funding blip). Mechanism before data: long spot when funding crosses UP through a small positive level (bias flipped bullish) AND a short-window ret is positive (price confirming); hold while the trend runs; exit when funding flips back negative (bias died) or barriers fire. Distinct from funding-gated-momentum (funding LEVEL ceiling, momentum must already be high) and funding-carry-long-spot (positive funding LEVEL to harvest, not the flip instant). Disconfirmer 1: replace cross_up with a funding LEVEL gt — if the static read matches the deflated Sharpe, the flip timing adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: drop the momentum arm — if a bare funding flip matches, it is a funding-direction proxy, not an ignition edge. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): net of ~20bps the post-flip continuation must clear. tier0 funding_rate + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS.
catalyst: funding crosses UP through zero (perp bias flips bullish) WHILE price momentum confirms — a trend ignition, ridden on spot
